name: button
title: Button
summary: Starts an action. The primary button is the one ink fill on a view.
use: primary for the main action of a view, at most one.
secondary for the other actions next to it.
ghost for quiet actions in toolbars and lists.

options.name: variant
options.description: How much the action stands out.

options.name: fullWidth
options.description: Fill the container, for forms and narrow screens.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Shown at 40% opacity and ignores input.

options.name: href
options.description: Web only: renders a link that looks like a button.

options.name: destructive
options.description: An action that removes or discards: its words take the error role, on a hairline.

rules: Labels are a verb or a verb and a noun, in sentence case.
Pressed scales to 96% unless the reader prefers reduced motion.
A destructive action is never the filled button; its words take the error role.
Primary and secondary are raised caps that sink when pressed; ghost is flat until pressed.
accessibility: Focus shows a 2px ink outline 3px away.
